# Same horizon. Shared adventures.

The server is live at play.mythforge.win. Apply for the whitelist, install Mythforge, and make your mark in a persistent multiplayer world.

## Before you connect

You need **Mythforge: Beyond the Horizon** installed. A vanilla client or a different modpack will not have the mods required to join.

1.3.1

Use the matching pack version when joining. Check release announcements before updating.

## How to join

1.  Install the Mythforge pack using the  [Getting Started guide](https://mythforge.win/getting-started/) .
2.  Launch the matching version and open **Multiplayer**.
3.  Apply through the  [whitelist form](https://mythforge.win/apply/)  and wait for server-confirmed approval.
4.  Select **Mythforge Official Server** if it is already listed, or add **play.mythforge.win** manually, and join.

 [Discord support](https://discord.gg/QQwdEgFMFg)  [Get the modpack](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/mythforge-beyond-the-horizon)

Good to know

## Server questions, answered.

Can I join with vanilla Minecraft?

No. Install Mythforge and use the same pack version as the server.

Which version should I use?

The required version is **1.3.1**. Install the latest published release; the server follows the latest version.

What happens if I cannot connect?

Verify the server address and modpack version, restart the game, and check maintenance announcements. See  [troubleshooting](https://mythforge.win/getting-started/#troubleshooting)  for more help.

Can I support the server?

The supporter page explains current ranks and rewards. Read the full package descriptions, commands and restrictions on the supporter page, then continue to the official Tebex storefront. All supporter rewards can also be earned through gameplay.

Built for the long journey

## Help keep the forge lit.

Support goes toward keeping a shared world running. Supporter rewards are also available through gameplay.

 [Supporter ranks →](https://mythforge.win/support/)

## The shared horizon is open.

Mythforge’s engineering, magic, building and adventure are designed with multiplayer in mind. Build a workshop together, compare magical discoveries or prepare for the next boss as a group. The live official server at play.mythforge.win gives that freedom a shared home.

## An adventure worth sharing.

Careful integration, quality-of-life and a strong sense of discovery make Mythforge an inviting choice for friends seeking a long-term NeoForge world. Apply for the whitelist, install the matching pack and join the community.

Before joining,  [get to know Mythforge](https://mythforge.win/modpack/)  and  [install the pack](https://mythforge.win/getting-started/)  and apply for the whitelist.
